scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --include=dev --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:turbo --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:live: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:live --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:poll: concurrently --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:poll --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
